stories.title: There are very few reasons for Unai Emery to leave Aston Villa for Manchester United | Jonathan Wilson
summary: Will he look at the home bench and imagine himself sitting there – or perhaps more plausibly, scuttling up and down in front of it – as the first Manchester United manager since Sir Alex Ferguson to land a league title?Perhaps not.
Emery is, after all, in “advanced talks” to extend a contract at Villa that already runs to 2029.
He feels the right fit for Villa, and that is arguably the most important factor in determining success.

summary: Wait long enough, and results will come to reflect performances.
Manchester City may have won their first seven games of the season, but they always looked vulnerable, and now have lost three in a row.
Nottingham Forest may have been second bottom but, other than the twin curses of missing chances and giving away daft goals, they seemed to be playing reasonably well.

stories.title: Martin Ødegaard extends Arsenal lead at top with winner to break Hull resistance
summary: As most Arsenal supporters would testify, patience is a virtue.
Martin Ødegaard had other ideas and the Arsenal captain’s fifth goal of the season was enough to ensure they will go into the international break with a healthy lead over Manchester City.
Enzo Maresca’s side are up next here in the league after the international break, with Arsenal having matched their record tally of 27 points from their opening 10 games.

stories.title: Muniz rescues late point for Fulham against Newcastle after Murphy stunner
summary: Questions over whether Álvaro Arbeloa and Matthias Jaissle have what it takes to succeed in the Premier League remain unanswered after these two young foreign managers watched their sides grind out a 1-1 draw at Craven Cottage.Arbeloa’s Fulham lacked fizz, physicality and personality before rescuing a point thanks to a late equaliser from Rodrigo Muniz, while Newcastle displayed little of Jaissle’s high-octane philosophy and squandered the chance to move into the top half after failing to build on a vicious opening goal from Jacob Murphy.
